title: Rival's Durability
description: With this mod you can see players' Durability/Health .
body:
# Rival's Durability

Rival's Durability is a client-side Minecraft mod that lets you view nearby players' armor durability and health directly above their heads.

You can also display your own armor durability on your HUD without opening your inventory.

## Features

* See nearby players' armor durability 
* See nearby players' health 
* Show or hide durability numbers
* Show your own armor durability on your HUD
* Move your own durability HUD by dragging it
* Customize armor icon size, durability text size, and overlay height
* Open the settings menu with the **K** key
* Fully client-side

## Settings

Press **K** in-game to open the Rival's Durability settings menu.

From the menu, you can:

* Enable or disable the mod
* Show or hide durability text
* Show or hide player health
* Show or hide your own durability HUD
* Change icon and text sizes
* Move your own HUD position

## Warning

This mod may not be allowed on some servers.

Because it can show information about other players, some servers may consider it unfair or against their rules. Use it at your own risk and always check the server rules before using it.
